Field Descriptions

AGENT_CAPS_RESERVED - Reserved

AGENT_CAPS bits 13-15: reserved. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Reset 0.

AGENT_CAPS_FIFO_CMS_SUPPORT - FIFO CMS Support

AGENT_CAPS bit 12: FIFO CMS support (INDIRECT_FIFO_CTRL). OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Reset 1. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

AGENT_CAPS_FLASHLESS_BOOT - Flashless Boot

AGENT_CAPS bit 11: Flashless boot (from RESET). OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Advertised 1: this design supports flashless boot (host writes DEVICE_RESET.FORCED_RECOVERY=0xE to enter flashless boot on the next platform reset). Firmware-configurable (sw=rw), reset default 1; the USB host is RO -- a host write to PROT_CAP raises PROTOCOL_ERROR (Sec 9.1). Sets AGENT_CAPS = 0x1E9B.

AGENT_CAPS_VENDOR_COMMAND - Vendor Command

AGENT_CAPS bit 10: Vendor command (VENDOR). OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Reset 1. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

AGENT_CAPS_HARDWARE_STATUS - Hardware Status

AGENT_CAPS bit 9: Hardware status (HW_STATUS). OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Reset 1. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

AGENT_CAPS_INTERFACE_ISOLATION - Interface Isolation

AGENT_CAPS bit 8: Interface isolation. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Not supported; reset 0. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

AGENT_CAPS_PUSH_C_IMAGE - Push C-image Support

AGENT_CAPS bit 7: Push C-image support (FIFO streaming boot). OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Reset 1. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

AGENT_CAPS_LOCAL_C_IMAGE - Local C-image Support

AGENT_CAPS bit 6: Local C-image support. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Not supported; reset 0. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

AGENT_CAPS_RECOVERY_MEM_ACCESS - Recovery Memory Access

AGENT_CAPS bit 5: Recovery memory access (direct CMS-memory window via INDIRECT_CTRL/STATUS/DATA, OCP commands 0x29/0x2A/0x2B). This agent is FIFO-only; the direct memory window is NOT implemented (the direct CMS-memory window register definitions were removed). Reset 0. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

AGENT_CAPS_DEVICE_STATUS - Device Status

AGENT_CAPS bit 4: Device status (DEVICE_STATUS). OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Reset 1. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

AGENT_CAPS_DEVICE_RESET - Device Reset

AGENT_CAPS bit 3: Device Reset (from RESET). OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Reset 1. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

AGENT_CAPS_MGMT_RESET - Management Reset

AGENT_CAPS bit 2: Mgmt reset (from RESET). OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Not supported; reset 0. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

AGENT_CAPS_FORCED_RECOVERY - Forced Recovery

AGENT_CAPS bit 1: Forced Recovery (from RESET). OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Reset 1. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

AGENT_CAPS_IDENTIFICATION - Identification

AGENT_CAPS bit 0: Identification (DEVICE_ID structure). OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Reset 1. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); the USB host is RO -- a host write to PROT_CAP raises PROTOCOL_ERROR (Sec 9.1, source-qualified via rb_is_ext in usb_ocp_recovery_rb_adapter.sv).

REC_PROT_VERSION - Recovery protocol version

Bytes 8-9 encode major=1 and minor=1 for OCP Recovery v1.1. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Static read-only constant: the RDL reset is the single source of truth (no hw drive).
